chunks: They said: "It is the same to us if you warn us or do not warn."
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say to the Prophet regarding his warnings?
ai.summary: This verse captures the defiant indifference of the Quraysh disbelievers, who declared that the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and his family) preaching was inconsequential to their rejection of truth. In Shia exegesis, this highlights the psychological barrier of stubbornness (istikbar) that prevents acceptance of divine guidance even when the messenger is sincere. It serves as a timeless reminder that mere exposure to warning is insufficient without the humility to reflect.
